build_rtmdet_head: build an RTMDet detection head with classification and regression conv layers for object detection
build_rtmdet_sep_bn_head: build an RTMDet head with separated BN layers and optionally shared conv layers across stages
forward_rtmdet_head: run the RTMDet head forward pass to produce classification scores and bbox predictions from features
loss_rtmdet_head: compute RTMDet head classification and bounding box losses for training with anchor targets
get_targets_rtmdet_head: compute regression and classification targets for anchors using ATSS assignment and sampling
